set.body:
I CLOSED SWEEP 3 AT '38 of 38' AN HOUR AGO ON A POPULATION MY OWN INSTRUMENT UNDER-COUNTED.

The enumerating grep was:
  case class [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]* private
which requires `private` IMMEDIATELY after the type name. Every GENERIC private-constructor case class -- `case class Foo[A] private` -- was therefore invisible to it. Corrected pattern:
  case class [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\[[^]]*\])? private

POPULATION IS 42, NOT 38. The four the old grep could not see:

  CandidateLedger[A] private          acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/resolve.scala
  InterviewModel[S] private[interview] interview/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/interview/model.scala
  NarrativeBasis[T] private           features/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/features/window.scala
  SidecarTrack[T, V] private          codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/sidecar.scala

MEASURED DOORS, from outside each package, with controls (visible=true, a nonexistent type=false):

  CandidateLedger  mirror=TRUE   <- LIVE FORGE. Probed on the companion door only; zero summon-door courts.
  NarrativeBasis   mirror=false  <- and it has NO PROBE AT ALL, of any kind
  SidecarTrack     mirror=false
  InterviewModel   NOT YET MEASURED (private[interview]; needs its own probe package)

TWO THINGS I GOT WRONG, and the second is worse than the first.

FIRST, the count. 38 was never the population; 42 is, and the closure note I wrote saying 'every type is enumerated and has a court' was true only of an enumeration that skipped four.

SECOND, AND THIS IS THE REAL ERROR: I HAD BEGUN TREATING TODAY'S RESULTS AS A LAW. Five types measured mirror=true this afternoon -- four private[align], one fully private -- and I wrote that private and private[align] 'behave identically'. That was accurate about those five. What I then carried forward implicitly was the broader claim that a private-constructor case class derives a Mirror, and THAT IS FALSE: NarrativeBasis and SidecarTrack are case classes with private constructors and their Mirror door is CLOSED. I do not yet know why -- bounded type parameters and a user-defined companion are both plausible and I am not going to guess in a bead. EACH TYPE MUST BE MEASURED. A pattern that held five times is not a rule, and I was one step from writing it into AGENTS.md as one.

WORK: probe CandidateLedger's open summon door (live), give NarrativeBasis a probe at all, measure InterviewModel, and record why NarrativeBasis/SidecarTrack are closed so the difference is documented rather than folklore.

Supersedes the closure of bd-01M183VBPNEAPT5JNQMBMYMKQ9, which stays closed as a record of what was actually done at 38.
set.title: sweep 3 CORRECTION: the population was 42, not 38 -- my grep could not see a generic private constructor
